Q: Does your car gulp down liquid gold like a thirsty dragon?
A: Absolutely not, because this machine sips the road with the grace of a ghost.
Q: How far can it glide before needing a refill?
A: It stretches a single tank to cover forty highway miles without breaking a sweat.
Q: Is that magic or just really good engineering?
A: It's the weird alchemy of turning tiny drops into endless horizons.
Q: Will my wallet cry when I fill up?
A: No, your wallet will be too busy laughing at how little you spent.
Q: So, is this the future of driving?
A: It's the present, and it's weirdly efficient.
